description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plot_BoxWhisker' which implements a box and whisker plot for the Image_Graph PHP library. It includes methods for drawing vertical and horizontal box plots, setting whisker size, and rendering the plot on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_BoxWhisker
classes.description: A class for rendering box and whisker charts within the Image_Graph PHP library.

methods.name: _drawBoxWhiskerV
methods.description: Draws a vertical box and whisker plot with circles at min, Q1, median, Q3, max and connecting lines.

methods.name: _drawBoxWhiskerH
methods.description: Draws a horizontal box and whisker plot with circles at min, Q1, median, Q3, max and connecting lines.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample representation of the box whisker plot for the legend.

methods.name: setWhiskerSize
methods.description: Sets the size (radius) of the whisker circles/dots.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Performs the rendering of the box whisker plot on the canvas.
